```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

## Load Packages

```{r packages}
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggnewscale)
```

## A1. Load and Clean Occurrence Data

```{r load-data}
raw_df <- read.csv(
  "~/Desktop/0073024-260519110011954.csv",
  sep      = "\t",
  header   = TRUE,
  quote    = "",
  fill     = TRUE,
  encoding = "UTF-8"
)

# Remove rows with missing coordinates
good    <- complete.cases(raw_df[ , c("decimalLatitude", "decimalLongitude")])
cleaned <- raw_df[good, ]
cat("Records after removing NAs:", nrow(cleaned), "\n")
```

## A2. Remove Records Outside the Philippines

```{r filter-bbox}
ph_lon_min <- 116; ph_lon_max <- 127
ph_lat_min <-   4; ph_lat_max <-  22

cleaned <- cleaned %>%
  filter(
    decimalLongitude >= ph_lon_min,
    decimalLongitude <= ph_lon_max,
    decimalLatitude  >= ph_lat_min,
    decimalLatitude  <= ph_lat_max
  )
cat("Records after spatial filtering (PH bounding box):", nrow(cleaned), "\n")

cleaned <- cleaned %>%
  filter(countryCode == "PH")
cat("Records after country code filter:", nrow(cleaned), "\n")

head(cleaned[ , c("gbifID", "species", "stateProvince",
                  "decimalLatitude", "decimalLongitude",
                  "year", "basisOfRecord")], 10)
```

## A3. Convert to Spatial Object

```{r make-sf}
occ_sf <- st_as_sf(
  cleaned,
  coords = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"),
  crs    = 4326
)
cat("CRS of occurrence points:", st_crs(occ_sf)$Name, "\n")
cat("Total occurrence points:", nrow(occ_sf), "\n")
```

## A4. Load Provincial Boundaries and Subset Tarsier Provinces

```{r provinces}
phl_adm1 <- st_read("~/Desktop/PHL_adm/PHL_adm1.shp", quiet = TRUE)
cat("Province shapefile CRS:", st_crs(phl_adm1)$Name, "\n")

# Match CRS and fix invalid geometries
occ_sf   <- st_transform(occ_sf, st_crs(phl_adm1))
phl_adm1 <- st_make_valid(phl_adm1)

# Spatial join to find which province each point falls in
pts_province <- st_join(occ_sf, phl_adm1[ , "NAME_1"], join = st_within)

# Get unique province names with records
province_names <- pts_province %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(!is.na(NAME_1)) %>%
  distinct(NAME_1) %>%
  pull(NAME_1)

cat("\nProvinces with Tarsier records:\n")
print(sort(province_names))

# Subset shapefile to those provinces only
tarsier_provinces <- phl_adm1 %>%
  filter(NAME_1 %in% province_names)

cat("\nNumber of provinces subsetted:", nrow(tarsier_provinces), "\n")
```

## A5. Clip DEM to Tarsier Provinces

```{r clip-dem}
phil_dem <- rast("~/Desktop/ph_strm_geo.tif")
cat("DEM CRS:", crs(phil_dem, describe = TRUE)$name, "\n")
cat("DEM extent:", as.character(ext(phil_dem)), "\n")
cat("DEM layers:", nlyr(phil_dem), "\n")

# Reproject provinces to match DEM CRS
tarsier_prov_proj <- st_transform(tarsier_provinces, crs(phil_dem))

# Crop and mask
dem_clipped        <- crop(phil_dem, tarsier_prov_proj) |> mask(tarsier_prov_proj)
names(dem_clipped) <- "elevation"
cat("Clipped DEM extent:", as.character(ext(dem_clipped)), "\n")
```

## B. Create the Distribution Map

```{r prep-map-data}
# Convert DEM to data frame for ggplot
dem_df <- as.data.frame(dem_clipped, xy = TRUE)
dem_df <- dem_df[!is.na(dem_df$elevation), ]

# Reproject layers to match DEM CRS
occ_plot  <- st_transform(occ_sf, crs(dem_clipped))
prov_plot <- st_transform(tarsier_provinces, crs(dem_clipped))
phl_bg    <- st_transform(phl_adm1, crs(dem_clipped))

# Keep only points within subsetted provinces
occ_in_prov <- st_join(occ_plot, prov_plot[ , "NAME_1"], join = st_within) %>%
  filter(!is.na(NAME_1))

cat("Points used in final map:", nrow(occ_in_prov), "\n")
```

```{r final-map, fig.width=10, fig.height=9}
elev_colors <- c("#1a6b6b", "#5aaa7c", "#b8d96c",
                 "#f5d76e", "#e07b39", "#8b1a1a")

tarsier_map <- ggplot() +

  # Layer 1: DEM
  geom_tile(
    data = dem_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y, fill = elevation),
    show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = elev_colors,
    name   = "Elevation (m)",
    guide  = guide_colorbar(
      title.position = "top",
      barwidth       = 0.8,
      barheight      = 6
    )
  ) +

  # Layer 2: Province outlines
  geom_sf(
    data      = prov_plot,
    fill      = NA,
    color     = "white",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  # Layer 3: Province labels
  geom_sf_text(
    data          = prov_plot,
    aes(label     = NAME_1),
    size          = 2.3,
    color         = "white",
    fontface      = "bold",
    check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +

  # Layer 4: Occurrence points
  new_scale_fill() +
  geom_sf(
    data   = occ_in_prov,
    aes(fill = basisOfRecord),
    shape  = 21,
    color  = "white",
    size   = 2.4,
    stroke = 0.6,
    alpha  = 0.88
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "PRESERVED_SPECIMEN"  = "#e63946",
      "HUMAN_OBSERVATION"   = "#ffd166",
      "MACHINE_OBSERVATION" = "#06d6a0",
      "LITERATURE"          = "#118ab2"
    ),
    name   = "Record Type",
    labels = c(
      "PRESERVED_SPECIMEN"  = "Museum Specimen",
      "HUMAN_OBSERVATION"   = "Field Observation",
      "MACHINE_OBSERVATION" = "Machine Observation",
      "LITERATURE"          = "Literature"
    ),
    guide  = guide_legend(
      title.position = "top",
      override.aes   = list(size = 3.5)
    )
  ) +

  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title    = expression(bold("Distribution of Philippine Tarsier") ~
                            italic("(Carlito syrichta)")),
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Class: Mammalia  |  Order: Primates  |  Family: Tarsiidae\n",
      "n = ", nrow(occ_in_prov), " georeferenced occurrence records (GBIF)"
    ),
    x       = "Longitude (°E)",
    y       = "Latitude (°N)",
    caption = paste0(
      "Data sources: GBIF Occurrence Download (2026) | ",
      "DIVA-GIS PHL Admin Boundaries | Ph STRM DEM\n",
      "Coordinate Reference System: WGS 84"
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold",
                                 hjust = 0.5, color = "#1a1a2e"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5,
                                 color = "gray40", margin = margin(b = 8)),
    plot.caption  = element_text(size = 7, color = "gray55",
                                 hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 6)),
    axis.title    = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray30"),
    axis.text     = element_text(size = 8, color = "gray40"),
    legend.position   = "right",
    legend.box        = "vertical",
    legend.title      = element_text(size = 8.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "gray80",
                                     linewidth = 0.3),
    legend.margin     = margin(4, 6, 4, 6),
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "#d0e8f5"),
    panel.border      = element_rect(color = "gray30", linewidth = 0.7),
    panel.grid.major  = element_line(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3,
                                     linetype = "dashed")
  )

print(tarsier_map)
```

## Save the Map

```{r save-map}
ggsave(
  filename = "Surname_tarsier_distribution_map.png",
  plot     = tarsier_map,
  width    = 10,
  height   = 9,
  dpi      = 300,
  bg       = "white"
)
cat("Map saved successfully!\n")
```
